blocks.prompt:
1 Explain the therapeutic window of a drug. Define minimum effective concentration, minimum toxic concentration and duration of action, and explain the importance of a wide and a narrow window. (4 marks)
(Drug ki therapeutic window samjhayein. Minimum effective concentration, minimum toxic concentration aur duration of action ki tareef karein, aur wide aur narrow window ki ahmiyat batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Therapeutic window: plasma mein drug concentration ki woh range jo asar kare magar nuqsan-deh side effects na de. Yeh medicine ka 'sweet spot' hai: na itni kam ke be-asar, na itni ziyada ke khatarnak.

• MEC: woh kam se kam dose jis se neeche drug ilaaji asar nahi deta (window ki nichli had).
• MTC: woh kam se kam dose jis par drug nuqsan ya zehar shuru karta hai (oopri had).
• Duration of action: jitna waqt concentration window ke andar rehti hai.

Wide window: asar wali aur nuqsan-deh dose mein bara faasla; drug mehfooz aur dose mein gunjaish.
Narrow window: effective dose toxic dose ke bohat qareeb; drug kam mehfooz, doctor bohat ehtiyaat karte aur blood check karte hain.

Kai dawaiyan aik saath, genetic factors, motapa, umar aur sehat bhi window par asar daalte hain kyun ke yeh drug ka metabolism aur asar control karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Therapeutic window is the range of drug concentrations in the plasma

blocks.prompt:
2 Define therapeutic index. Explain TD₅₀ and ED₅₀, and discuss the significance of high and low TI with examples. What is therapeutic drug monitoring? (4 marks)
(Therapeutic index ki tareef karein. TD₅₀ aur ED₅₀ samjhayein, aur misaalon ke saath ziyada aur kam TI ki ahmiyat batayein. Therapeutic drug monitoring kya hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Therapeutic index (TI): drug ki safety ki miqdaari pemaish. Yeh toxic dose ko effective dose se compare karta hai:
TI = TD₅₀ / ED₅₀ (figure mein ulta chhapa hai, woh ghalat hai)

• TD₅₀: woh dose jo lene walon mein se 50% par zehreela asar kare.
• ED₅₀: woh dose jo lene walon mein se 50% par kaam kare.

Ziyada TI: effective aur toxic dose mein bara farq, drug mehfooz; maslan penicillin aur paracetamol, ghalti se double dose bhi jaan ke liye khatra nahi. TI 10 wala drug TI 2 wale se kahin mehfooz hai.
Kam TI: drug khatarnak, nigrani zaroori; maslan warfarin (blood thinner) aur digoxin (dil ki dawa). Digoxin ka TI itna kam hai ke khane ya dawaon ka chhota asar bhi mareez ko jaan-lewa zone mein le jata tha.

Therapeutic drug monitoring (TDM): kam TI drugs lene walon ke regular blood tests ta ke drug level mehfooz rahe.

book_ref.quote: The therapeutic index (TI) is a quantitative measurement of a drug

blocks.prompt:
3 Drug X has ED₅₀ = 12 mg and TD₅₀ = 300 mg. Drug Y has ED₅₀ = 40 mg and TD₅₀ = 120 mg. Calculate the therapeutic index of each drug and state which drug is safer and which one needs therapeutic drug monitoring. (4 marks)
(Drug X ka ED₅₀ = 12 mg aur TD₅₀ = 300 mg hai. Drug Y ka ED₅₀ = 40 mg aur TD₅₀ = 120 mg hai. Dono ka therapeutic index nikalein aur batayein kaun sa ziyada mehfooz hai aur kis ko TDM chahiye.)
blocks.explanation: Har drug ke liye TI = TD₅₀/ED₅₀ lagayein; jis ka TI ziyada woh ziyada mehfooz.

book_ref.quote: It compares the dose that causes a toxic effect to the dose that produces a desired therapeutic effect.

steps: 25 > 3, is liye drug X mein effective aur toxic dose ka faasla kahin ziyada hai.
Drug Y ki effective dose toxic dose ke qareeb hai, is liye us ki nigrani (TDM) zaroori hai.
blocks.final_answer: TI(X) = 25, TI(Y) = 3; drug X ziyada mehfooz; drug Y ko TDM chahiye.

blocks.prompt:
4 Answer both parts. (i) A drug has a therapeutic index of 6 and ED₅₀ = 35 mg. Find its TD₅₀. (ii) Another drug has MEC = 8 mg dm⁻³ and MTC = 32 mg dm⁻³. State whether plasma concentrations of 6, 20 and 40 mg dm⁻³ are ineffective, within the therapeutic window or toxic. (4 marks)
(Dono hissay hal karein. (i) Aik drug ka TI = 6 aur ED₅₀ = 35 mg hai. Is ka TD₅₀ nikalein. (ii) Doosre drug ka MEC = 8 mg dm⁻³ aur MTC = 32 mg dm⁻³ hai. Batayein ke 6, 20 aur 40 mg dm⁻³ concentrations be-asar, window ke andar ya toxic hain.)
blocks.explanation: (i) mein TI = TD₅₀/ED₅₀ ko ulat kar TD₅₀ nikalein; (ii) mein har concentration ko MEC aur MTC se compare karein.

book_ref.quote: This allows more flexibility in dosing.

steps: (i) TI = TD₅₀ / ED₅₀, is liye TD₅₀ = TI × ED₅₀
20 mg dm⁻³ 8 aur 32 ke darmiyan: window ke andar
blocks.final_answer: (i) TD₅₀ = 210 mg. (ii) 6 be-asar; 20 window ke andar; 40 toxic.

blocks.prompt:
5 Explain the importance of pH in the stomach. How does the stomach protect itself, and how does its low pH affect drugs taken by mouth? (4 marks)
(Maiday mein pH ki ahmiyat samjhayein. Maida apne aap ko kaise bachata hai, aur us ki kam pH munh se li gayi dawaon par kya asar daalti hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Maiday mein bohat tezabi mahol hai, pH 1.5–3.5.

Qaim kaise: parietal cells H⁺ ions maiday mein pump karte hain.
Ahmiyat: yeh tezaab khana hazam karne aur bacteria maarne ke liye zaroori hai.
Apni hifazat: maida mucus aur bicarbonate ions ki moti teh se bachta hai jo cell ki satah par tezaab neutral karte hain.

Dawaon par asar: kam pH non-specific reactions karti hai, yani kuch drugs ko kimiyaai taur par badal deti hai. Kuch drugs khoon mein jazb hone se pehle hi toot jate hain. Is liye kuch dawaon par coating hoti hai jo sirf kam tezabi small intestine mein hal hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Although the stomach has very low pH but it protects itself

blocks.prompt:
6 Explain the double role of the beta-lactam ring of penicillin: in its antibiotic action and in its deactivation by bacteria. Why is penicillin harmless to human cells? Name two infections it treats. (4 marks)
(Penicillin ki beta-lactam ring ka dohra kirdar samjhayein: antibiotic amal mein aur bacteria ke hathon be-asar hone mein. Penicillin insani cells ke liye be-zarar kyun hai? Do infections ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Penicillin mein do bunyaadi rings hain: chaar-rukni beta-lactam ring aur paanch-rukni thiazolidine ring, dono par side chains.

Amal mein kirdar: penicillin us bacterial enzyme ke asal substrate jaisi hai jo cell wall mazboot karta hai, is liye enzyme penicillin ko le leta hai. Beta-lactam ring khul kar hamesha ke liye jud jati hai aur enzyme be-asar ho jata hai. Bacteria baghair cell wall ke barhte aur aakhir phat kar mar jate hain. Is liye yeh ring antibiotic activity ke liye zaroori hai.

Be-asar hone mein kirdar: isi ring par bacteria ke enzymes beta-lactamases hamla kar ke penicillin ko be-asar karte hain.

Hifazat: insani cells ki cell wall nahi hoti, is liye penicillin unhein nuqsan nahi deti.

Istemal: saans ke infections (strep throat, pneumonia, scarlet fever, sinusitis) aur jild ke infections (cellulitis, erysipelas).

book_ref.quote: The beta-lactam ring is crucial for the antibiotic

blocks.prompt:
7 What are opiates? Describe the concept of opioid receptors, including endorphins and the three types of receptors with their roles. (4 marks)
(Opiates kya hain? Opioid receptors ka tasawwur bayan karein, endorphins aur teen qism ke receptors aur un ke kaam samait.)
blocks.explanation:
Opiates afeem ke poday se aane wale drugs hain. Dard ke liye taqatwar magar nasha-awar. Legal: morphine, codeine, oxycodone, hydrocodone; illegal: heroin.

Endorphins: dimagh apne painkillers endorphins banata hai jo CNS ke opioid receptors se judte hain. Opiates is qudrati nizam ko 'hijack' karte hain: unhi receptors se jud kar dard kam karte magar nasha lagate hain.

Opioid receptors dimagh aur spinal cord ke khaas proteins hain. Teen qismein:

book_ref.quote: There are three types of opioid receptors.

rows: Dimagh aur spinal cord; morphine jaise opioids ka asal nishana; dard kam, magar saans dheemi aur shadeed euphoria bhi
Spinal analgesia aur sedation (ghanoodgi); euphoria kam
Jazbati radd-e-amal aur mood control mein aham

blocks.prompt:
8 Describe the mechanism of action of opiates at the neuron and explain why they cause a feeling of well-being. Give their medical uses. (4 marks)
(Neuron par opiates ka mechanism of action bayan karein aur samjhayein ke yeh sukoon ka ehsaas kyun dete hain. In ke ilaaji istemal likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Opiates opioid receptors (dimagh aur spinal cord ke khaas proteins) se judte hain, jaise chaabi (opiate) taale (receptor) mein.

Mechanism:
1. Opiate receptor se jud kar dard ke signals ko dimagh tak pohanchne se rokta hai, dard kam mehsoos hota hai.
2. Asal mein judne se calcium channels band aur potassium channel khul jata hai.
3. Is se neuron hyperpolarize hota hai aur dard ka signal bhejna bohat mushkil ho jata hai.
4. Opiates dimagh ke reward center mein dopamine ka ziyada ikhraaj karwate hain jo sukoon aur khushi deta hai (aur nasha lagata hai).

Ilaaji istemal:
• Achanak, thori der ke dard aur cancer ke shadeed dard mein aaraam.
• Codeine khansi ke sharbat mein, khansi ka reflex dabati hai.
• Nizam-e-hazma ke receptors se jud kar hazma dheema aur dast mein aaraam.

book_ref.quote: When the opiate binds to the receptor, it blocks pain signals from reaching the brain

blocks.prompt:
9 Explain the challenges in treating viral infections and describe how antiviral medications work. (4 marks)
(Viral infections ke ilaaj ki mushkilaat samjhayein aur bayan karein ke antiviral dawaiyan kaise kaam karti hain.)
blocks.explanation:
Mushkilaat:
1. Virus ki fitrat: bacteria azad zinda jandar hain, viruses parasites hain jo haqeeqat mein zinda nahi. Viruses hamare cells mein reh kar hamari DNA/RNA machinery se nuqool banate hain, is liye aisi dawa mushkil hai jo virus maare magar sehatmand cells bachaye.
2. Mutation: viruses genetic material tezi se badalte hain; jo dawa aik saal kaam kare agle saal shayad na kare; isi liye flu vaccine har saal nayi.
3. Soye hue viruses: viruses genome mein saalon soye reh sakte hain; aaj ki dawaiyan sirf active viruses maarti hain.

Antivirals ka amal: virus ke life cycle ke khaas marahil ko nishana.
• Kuch virus ko cell mein dakhil hone se, kuch genetic material ki nakal se rokte hain.
• Enzyme inhibition aam tareeqa hai: virus proteins aik lambi lari (polyprotein) mein banata hai; protease inhibitor viral protease ko yeh lari kaatne se rokta hai. HIV aur hepatitis C mein madadgar.
• Kuch immune response barhate hain: interferons proteins hain jo immune system taqatwar karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Antiviral medications work by targeting specific stages of the viral life cycle.

blocks.prompt:
10 What are fertilizers? Describe the essential elements required by plants, distinguishing macronutrients from micronutrients, and explain the term primary macronutrients. (4 marks)
(Fertilizers kya hain? Poudon ke zaroori elements bayan karein, macronutrients aur micronutrients ka farq batayein, aur primary macronutrients ki wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Fertilizers aise chemicals hain jo poudon ko zaroori ghiza de kar growth aur paidawar barhate hain; thaki mitti ko bharte hain. Synthetic khaad chemical tareeqon (maslan ammonia ka Haber-Bosch process) se banti hai; organic khaad compost ya gobar se aati hai.

Poudon ko satrah (17) zaroori elements chahiye:

Primary macronutrients: nau macronutrients mein se nitrogen, phosphorus aur potassium itni ziyada miqdaar mein chahiye ke unhein primary kehte hain. Khaad par N-P-K ratio in teen ki concentration batata hai.

book_ref.quote: Plants require seventeen essential elements, as micronutrients and macronutrients.

rows: Nau: carbon, hydrogen, oxygen, nitrogen, phosphorus, sulphur, potassium, calcium, magnesium
Boron, iron, copper, chlorine, manganese, molybdenum aur zinc
In mein primary N, P, K shamil
Sirf thori miqdaar mein; in mein koi primary nahi

blocks.prompt:
11 Explain how nitrogen, phosphorus and potassium take part in plant growth, and describe the harmful effects of overuse of fertilizers. How does crop rotation help? (4 marks)
(Nitrogen, phosphorus aur potassium poude ki growth mein kaise hissa lete hain, samjhayein; khaad ke ziyada istemal ke nuqsanat bayan karein. Crop rotation kaise madad karti hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Growth mein kirdar (jarein inhein jazb karti hain):
• Nitrogen: aksar paidawar ka sab se bara limiting factor; amino acids (proteins) aur chlorophyll ka bunyaadi hissa.
• Phosphorus: superphosphates ya ammonium phosphates ki shakal mein; ATP ka hissa jo energy jama aur kharch karta hai.
• Potassium: N aur P ke bar-aks banawat ka hissa nahi banta; osmoregulator hai aur saath se ziyada enzymes active karta hai.

Ziyada istemal ke nuqsanat:
• Ziyada khaad daryaon aur jheelon mein ja kar algae ki had se ziyada growth karti hai jo aabi zindagi ke liye nuqsan-deh hai.
• Lamba istemal mitti ki pH badalta aur mufeed microorganisms maarta hai.

Crop rotation: har saal aik hi fasal wahi ghiza khatam karti hai; fasal badalne se ghiza wapas aati aur synthetic khaad ki zaroorat kam hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: When applied, these chemicals are taken up by plant roots.

blocks.prompt:
12 Define pesticides. Describe the three classes of pesticides and the mode of action of each, with examples. (4 marks)
(Pesticides ki tareef karein. Pesticides ki teen qismein aur har aik ka tareeqa-e-amal misaalon ke saath bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Pesticides woh chemicals hain jo keeron, jangli ghaas ya phaphoondi ko maarte ya control karte hain; fasal bachate aur khoraak ki supply qaim rakhte hain. Nishane ke lihaz se:

1. Insecticides: keeron ke nizam-e-asaab ko nishana. Organophosphates aur neonicotinoids neurotoxins hain jo mafloj kar ke maarte hain. Neonicotinoids shehad ki makhiyon ke Colony Collapse Disorder se jure hain.

2. Herbicides: jangli ghaas (weeds) ko control. Kuch enzyme rok kar amino acids banne nahi dete; kuch electron transport bigaar kar photosynthesis rokte hain.

3. Fungicides: phaphoondi ke cell ki salamati ko nishana; kuch, jaise triazoles, cell membrane mein ergosterol banna rokte hain, membrane kamzor ho kar cell leak ho ke mar jata hai. Kuch, jaise strobilurins, fungus ke mitochondria mein respiration (energy banna) rok dete hain. (Zinc phosphide rodenticide hai, fungicide nahi.)

book_ref.quote: Pesticides protect crops from damage, preventing food loss and ensuring a stable food supply.

blocks.prompt:
13 Discuss the benefits of pesticides and their adverse effects on health and the environment. (4 marks)
(Pesticides ke fawaid aur sehat aur mahol par un ke bure asraat par bahas karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Fawaid:
• Jadeed food programs mein aham kirdar; poudon ko keeron aur beemariyon se bacha kar paidawar barhate hain.
• Wabaon ka khatra kam aur insani sehat behtar.
• Dunya bhar mein food security aur istehkaam.

Bure asraat:
• Cancer-aawar aur asaab ke liye zehreele ho sakte hain.
• Mufeed keere, parinde aur aabi jandar mutasir; kheton ka behta paani aabi zaraye ganda karta hai.
• Shehad ki makhiyon jaise pollinators ko nuqsan.
• Waqt ke saath keere immune ho jate hain, pesticide kam asar karta hai aur ziyada zehreele pesticides lagane parte hain.

book_ref.quote: Pesticides are playing a pivotal role in modern food development programs.

blocks.prompt:
14 What is acid rain? Explain its causes with equations and describe its effects on soil and crops, including the leaching equations. (4 marks)
(Acid rain kya hai? Is ki wajoohat equations ke saath samjhayein aur mitti aur faslon par asraat leaching equations samait bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Acid rain nitric aur sulphuric acid ka fizaai mixture hai jo industrial aaloodgi se banta hai. Aam barish ki pH carbonic acid ki wajah se 5.6 ya oopar; 5.6 se kam pH acid rain hai.

Wajoohat: SOₓ aur NOₓ paani se reaction karte hain:
2SO₂ + O₂ + 2H₂O → 2H₂SO₄ (sulphuric acid)
4NO₂ + O₂ + 2H₂O → 4HNO₃ (nitric acid)

Mitti par asar: H⁺ ions zaroori ghiza (Ca²⁺, Mg²⁺, K⁺) baha dete hain:
K⁺–Soil + H⁺ → H⁺–Soil + K⁺
Ca²⁺–Soil + 2H⁺ → (2H⁺)–Soil + Ca²⁺
Zehreele Al³⁺ ki hal-pazeeri barhti hai jo jaron ko nuqsan deta aur ghiza ka jazb kam karta hai:
Al³⁺–Soil + 3H⁺ → (3H⁺)–Soil + Al³⁺

Faslon par asar: pattiyan zakhmi aur khushk, poday beemari ka shikar; nitrogen fixation aur ghiza kam ho kar soyabean aur gandum ki paidawar ghatti hai; mitti ke microbes aur nutrient cycles bigarte hain. Al³⁺ jheelon mein machhliyon ke galphare bhi band karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Acid rain is caused due to sulphur oxides (SOₓ) and nitrogen oxides (NOₓ) in the atmosphere.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Leaching ko aise samjhein: mitti ke zarron par K⁺, Ca²⁺ chipke hote hain. Acid rain ke H⁺ un ki jagah le lete hain (charge barabar rakhne ke liye Ca²⁺ ke liye 2 H⁺, Al³⁺ ke liye 3 H⁺), aur nikle hue ions paani ke saath beh jate hain.

blocks.prompt:
15 Using the equation 2SO₂ + O₂ + 2H₂O → 2H₂SO₄, calculate the mass of sulphuric acid formed and the mass of oxygen used when 128 g of SO₂ forms acid rain. (Molar masses: SO₂ = 64 g mol⁻¹, O₂ = 32 g mol⁻¹, H₂SO₄ = 98 g mol⁻¹.) (4 marks)
(2SO₂ + O₂ + 2H₂O → 2H₂SO₄ ke mutabiq jab 128 g SO₂ acid rain banaye to banne wale sulphuric acid aur istemal hone wali oxygen ka mass nikalein. (Molar masses: SO₂ = 64, O₂ = 32, H₂SO₄ = 98 g mol⁻¹.))
blocks.explanation: SO₂ ka mass mol mein badlein, equation ka mole ratio lagayein, phir mol ko mass mein badlein.

book_ref.quote: These gases, often from industrial pollution, react with water to form sulphuric acid

steps: SO₂ : H₂SO₄ = 2 : 2, is liye H₂SO₄ = 2 mol
SO₂ : O₂ = 2 : 1, is liye O₂ = 1 mol
blocks.final_answer: 196 g H₂SO₄ banta hai aur 32 g O₂ istemal hoti hai.

blocks.prompt:
16 Using the equation 4NO₂ + O₂ + 2H₂O → 4HNO₃, calculate the mass of nitric acid formed and the mass of oxygen needed from 230 g of NO₂. (Molar masses: NO₂ = 46 g mol⁻¹, O₂ = 32 g mol⁻¹, HNO₃ = 63 g mol⁻¹.) (4 marks)
(4NO₂ + O₂ + 2H₂O → 4HNO₃ ke mutabiq 230 g NO₂ se banne wale nitric acid aur darkaar oxygen ka mass nikalein. (Molar masses: NO₂ = 46, O₂ = 32, HNO₃ = 63 g mol⁻¹.))
blocks.explanation: NO₂ ke mol nikalein, 4 : 4 aur 4 : 1 ratios lagayein, phir mass mein badlein.

book_ref.quote: If it has a pH lower than 5.6, it potentially becomes the acid rain.

steps: NO₂ : HNO₃ = 4 : 4, is liye HNO₃ = 5 mol
NO₂ : O₂ = 4 : 1, is liye O₂ = 5/4 = 1.25 mol
blocks.final_answer: 315 g HNO₃ banta hai aur 40 g O₂ chahiye.

blocks.prompt:
17 Describe the effects of climate change on crops. How are scientists helping crops to adapt? (4 marks)
(Mausami tabdeeli ke faslon par asraat bayan karein. Scientists faslon ko is ke mutabiq dhaalne mein kaise madad kar rahe hain?)
blocks.explanation:
Zaraat badalte mausam se sab se ziyada mutasir hoti hai; darja-e-hararat, barish aur shadeed mausam seedha asar daalte hain.

1. Darja-e-hararat: heat stress paani ki kami se photosynthesis aur respiration kamzor karta hai. Ziyada garmi metabolism tez magar had se ziyada ho to growth aur paidawar kam. Sardi kuch faslon ko nuqsan deti aur chhote poudon ke liye jaan-lewa hai.
2. Barish: aam barish paani aur ghiza deti hai, magar badla andaz kahin khushk-saali aur kahin selaab laata hai. Achanak barish aur cloud burst mitti ka kataao aur zarkhez oopri mitti ka nuqsan karte hain.
3. Shadeed waqiyaat: toofan, heatwaves aur olay fasal aur dhaancha tabah karte hain. Aandhiyan poday ukhaarti hain; tez hawa paani ka nuqsan karti hai; olay pattiyan, phal aur tane zakhmi karte hain; ziyada UV-index aur heat waves pattiyan jalate hain.

Mutabiqat: scientists naye bardasht-wale beej bana rahe hain, maslan khushk-saali bardasht makai, garmi bardasht gandum, aur 'Sub1 rice' jo do hafte paani mein zinda rehta hai.

book_ref.quote: Changes in temperature, precipitation, and extreme weather events due to climate change directly impact agriculture.

blocks.prompt:
18 Describe the steps by which a genetically modified crop is produced. Explain the examples of BT-cotton and Golden Rice. (4 marks)
(Genetically modified fasal banane ke marahil bayan karein. BT-cotton aur Golden Rice ki misaalein samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Zaraat mein genetic engineering genes jor kar, nikal kar ya badal kar DNA tabdeel karti hai ta ke pasandeeda khoobiyon wali GM faslein banein.

Marahil:
1. Pehchaan: mufeed gene dhoonda jata hai, maslan bacterium se keeron ke khilaaf gene, ya khushk-saali bardasht.
2. Alag karna: us khoobi ka gene jandar se alag kiya jata hai.
3. Dakhil karna: gene gun ya carrier bacterium ke zariye gene poude ke DNA mein 'sil' diya jata hai.
4. Izhaar: naya gene poude ke cells mein kaam karta hai; poda naya protein banata hai jo pehle nahi bana sakta tha.

Misaalein:
• BT-Cotton apna pesticide khud banati hai, spray kam lagta hai.
• Golden Rice mein beta-carotene hai ta ke taraqqi-pazeer mulkon mein andha-pan na ho.

Aisi faslein keeron, beemari aur herbicide ke khilaaf behtar aur ziyada ghizaiyat wali hoti hain.

book_ref.quote: Scientists identify a useful gene (e.g., for pest resistance from a bacterium)

blocks.prompt:
19 Why does the feedstock of an industry matter? Tabulate the raw materials of Pakistan with the chemicals or industries they supply. (4 marks)
(Kisi industry ka feedstock kyun aham hai? Pakistan ke khaam maal aur un se banne wale chemicals ya industries ki table banayein.)
blocks.explanation: Industry ka khaam maal us ki jagah aur maashi kamyabi tay karta hai. Hawa fertilizers ke liye nitrogen aur steel ke liye oxygen deti hai; paani solvent, thanda karne wala aur hydrogen ka zariya; fossil fuels 90% organic chemicals ke hydrocarbons dete hain. Pakistan ke khaam maal:

book_ref.quote: Pakistan possesses a unique geological profile that supports several chemical sub-sectors like:

rows: Methane (CH₄) se urea aur petrochemicals; fuel aur hydrogen ka zariya
NaCl se soda ash (Na₂CO₃), caustic soda (NaOH) aur chlorine
Cement, plaster, calcium aur sulphur ka zariya, soil conditioner

blocks.prompt:
20 Explain how the chemical industry supports agriculture, textiles and construction in Pakistan. (4 marks)
(Samjhayein ke chemical industry Pakistan mein zaraat, textile aur construction ki kaise madad karti hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Chemical industry Pakistan ke GDP mein bara hissa daalti aur rozgaar deti hai. Mulki khaam maal (natural gas, rock salt, limestone, crude oil) se imports par inhisaar kam karti hai.

• Zaraat: Pakistan zaraati mulk hai jis ki food security chemical industry par hai. Companies natural gas se urea banati hain jis se import bill arbon dollar kam hota hai.
• Textile: exports ka 50% se ziyada. Caustic soda cotton ki mercerizing, synthetic dyes rang aur pukhtagi, hydrogen peroxide bleaching ke liye; synthetic fibres bhi.
• Construction: cement; infrastructure aur shehri phailao ki wajah se cement industry hamsaya ilaqon ko bari exporter ban gayi hai.

book_ref.quote: It supports other major sectors like agriculture (through fertilizers)

blocks.prompt:
21 Describe polymerisation and its two types, and explain the refining and reforming of petroleum. (4 marks)
(Polymerisation aur us ki do qismein bayan karein, aur petroleum ki refining aur reforming samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Polymerisation: chhote molecules (monomers) jur kar bari zanjeerein (polymers) banate hain.
• Addition: monomers baghair koi atom khoye jurte hain, maslan ethylene se polyethene.
• Condensation: monomers jur kar chhota molecule, aam taur par paani, chhorte hain, maslan polyesters.
Engro Polymer and Chemicals Pakistan mein PVC ka wahid producer hai.

Refining: fractional distillation crude oil ko boiling points ki bunyaad par gasoline, diesel, kerosene waghera mein alag karti hai.

Reforming: seedhi zanjeer wale hydrocarbons ko branched bana kar fuel behtar karna. Catalytic reforming mein catalyst ke saath garam kar ke high-octane gasoline milti hai.

PARCO aur Attock Refinery ki cracking aur reforming chemical industry ko petrochemical khaam maal bhi deti hai.

book_ref.quote: Polymerisation: This is a process where small molecules called monomers link up

blocks.prompt:
22 Describe the Haber-Bosch process and the contact process, naming the catalyst of each and the Pakistani industries that run them. (4 marks)
(Haber-Bosch process aur contact process bayan karein, har aik ka catalyst aur Pakistan mein chalane wali industries ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Haber-Bosch process:
• N₂ aur H₂ gases se ammonia (NH₃) banti hai.
• Catalyst: iron (lohe) ke crystals.
• Ziyada tar ammonia khaad banane mein jati hai.
• Engro Fertilizers aur FFC natural gas se ammonia bana kar urea mein badalte hain.

Contact process:
• SO₂ ko V₂O₅ ya Pt catalyst se SO₃ banaya jata hai.
• SO₃ se oleum aur aakhir mein sulphuric acid.
• Khalis aur gaadha H₂SO₄ milta hai; dunya mein sab se ziyada istemal hone wala chemical, is liye 'King of Chemicals'.
• Pakistan mein Nimir Industrial Chemicals jaise plants yeh process chalate hain.

book_ref.quote: In Haber process ammonia (NH₃) gas is synthesized from nitrogen (N₂) and hydrogen (H₂) gases.

blocks.prompt:
23 Describe the Solvay process and the chlor-alkali process, giving their raw materials, products and uses. (4 marks)
(Solvay process aur chlor-alkali process bayan karein, un ke khaam maal, paidawar aur istemal samait.)
blocks.explanation:
Solvay process (sodium carbonate):
• Khaam maal: brine aur limestone.
• Brine mein ammonia mila kar CO₂ guzari jati hai, NaHCO₃ ka precipitate banta hai.
• Garam karne se NaHCO₃ Na₂CO₃ ban jata hai.
• CaCO₃ ke tootne se bane lime se ammonia wapas li jati hai; by-product CaCl₂.
• Lucky Core Industries (pehle ICI) glass, detergent aur paper ke liye soda ash banati hai.

Chlor-alkali process:
• NaCl brine ki industrial electrolysis.
• Paidawar: Cl₂, NaOH (caustic soda) aur H₂.
• Plastics, detergents aur paani saaf karne ki cheezon ke liye zaroori; jadeed plants membrane cell technology istemal karte hain.
• Sitara Chemical Industries aur Ittehad Chemicals bare idaray hain jo textile aur water treatment ki madad karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Lucky Core Industries (formerly ICI) produce soda ash for the glass, detergent and paper industries.

blocks.prompt:
24 Describe the applications of industrial chemistry in the petrochemical, cosmetics, cement and food industries. (4 marks)
(Petrochemical, cosmetics, cement aur food industries mein industrial chemistry ke istemal bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Petrochemical: crude oil se plastics, synthetic rubber aur fibres. Crude oil ko crack (tor) kar chhote molecules banaye jate hain jo lubricants, waxes aur synthetic rubber ki bunyaad hain.

2. Cosmetics: makeup, sabun aur perfume ke ajza; surfactants (sabun), emulsifiers (cream hamwaar) aur preservatives (bacteria rokna). Chemistry inhein jild ke liye pH-balanced banati hai.

3. Cement: limestone aur clay ka mixture rotary kiln mein 1500 °C tak garam, phir gypsum ke saath peesa jata hai. Paani ke saath exothermic hydration se taaza cement garam hota hai.

4. Food: sodium benzoate preservative; hydrogenation se tel margarine; sodium bicarbonate (baking soda) baking mein; fortification se namak mein iodine ya tel mein vitamin A.

book_ref.quote: Cosmetics industry creates ingredients for makeup, soaps, and perfumes.

blocks.prompt:
25 Explain the purpose of each of the following safety measures in a chemical facility: personal protective equipment, labelling and storage, emergency plans, ventilation, and training with inspection. (4 marks)
(Chemical facility mein in safety measures ka maqsad samjhayein: personal protective equipment, labelling aur storage, emergency plans, ventilation, aur training aur muainah.)
blocks.explanation:
Chemical facilities mein hadsaat rokne aur workers aur mahol ki hifazat ke liye sakht safety measures zaroori hain.

1. PPE: gloves, goggles, helmet, lab coat aur hifazati joote chemicals, garmi aur fumes se chot se bachate hain.
2. Labelling aur storage: chemicals par label, un ki khasoosiyat ke mutabiq rakhna; aag pakarne wale, zehreele ya corrosive maadde munasib dabbon mein alag jagah ta ke leak, girna ya khatarnak reaction na ho.
3. Emergency plans: aag, spill, gas leak ya dhamake ke liye wazeh plan; emergency exits, fire extinguishers, first-aid kits aur spill control saaman; workers ko maloom ho kya karna hai.
4. Ventilation: zehreeli gases, fumes aur dhool nikalta hai; nuqsan-deh cheezein saans mein jane ka khatra kam.
5. Training aur muainah: workers ko khatarnak maadde aur mashinein chalane ki training; machines, pipelines aur tanks ka regular muainah kharabi jaldi pakar kar hadsaat kam karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Industrial chemical facilities require strict safety measures to prevent accidents
